stated: Take big money out of politics by capping donations to political parties.

source.quote: Take big money out of politics by capping donations to political parties.

bearing_set.reason: Capping political donations directly regulates the democratic financing framework, affecting equal political participation, donor influence over parties, and the integrity of democratic/voting rights — squarely within O9's 'voting & democratic rights' scope.

Political donations are a form of political expression and association; a legal cap on what individuals or organisations may give is a state-imposed restriction on that freedom — a concrete mechanism that worsens the freedom-of-expression and freedom-from-state-coercion indicators under O10.

membership_note: Classic O9/O10 tension: the policy is designed to advance equal democratic participation (O9 improves) but does so by restricting a form of political speech and voluntary association (O10 worsens). No material bearing on other fundamentals — it is a constitutional/democratic-integrity measure with no direct effect on prices, public services, fiscal position, or living standards.
